data.title: "Unfolding Time: An interactive exhibition of medieval pocket calendars at Lambeth Palace Library"
data.description: "Lambeth Palace Library is opening a new chapter in its history, and ‘Unfolding Time’ kickstarts our strategy to find new ways to invite new audiences into our new building. We will harness the captivating power of medieval concertina-fold almanacs: rare, colourful and puzzle-like objects that speak to an inherent human interest in conceptualising time. Drawing on new research, our free exhibition brings a selection together for the first time and, with our holdings, takes visitors on a journey through the medieval past, present and future. Activity packs, virtual tours, models and a full events programme will invite visitors—online and in-person—to play with these dynamic objects, encouraging reflection on methods of passing and marking time in their own communities, classrooms and households. Forming relationships with local schools and interfaith groups in particular, ‘Unfolding Time’ will establish the Library as a welcoming place where everyone can learn about the past."

data.title: "Save the Roof of St Peter's, Little Cheverell"
data.description: "Our project has the primary aim of renovating the roof of the nave of our small church in the hamlet of Little Cheverell, near Devizes in Wiltshire, together with minor repairs to other areas of the church roof  We need to make the church weather proof again and ensure that the roof is structurally sound, thereby conserving this Grade II listed building and preserving a place of worship for the community for years to come.  We shall take the opportunity of our campaign to conduct a number of events to raise the profile of the church in our community, seeking to engender engagement and a sense of ownership of this traditionally central focus of community life.  We shall also take steps to develop the churchyard for wildlife and the environment."
